name: upscale-video-real-esrgan
title: Upscale a video 2 or 4 times with Real-ESRGAN
description: Raises the resolution of every frame of one clip with Real-ESRGAN x4plus and keeps its frame rate and sound. A 2 times run makes the 4 times frames and scales them down by half. Built from Comfy's template video_upscale_gan_x4.
